objectives.description: Add --findings flag, FINDINGS_LIST accumulator, CURRENT_GATE labels, extend fail(), exit-2 sentinels, gate-3 capture + per-FAIL extraction, gate-4 conditional re-invocation, sorted findings output, header docs

deviations.description: Extend fail() to append FINDING $CURRENT_GATE $1 to the accumulator.
deviations.reason: fail() gained an optional 3rd argument that overrides or (if empty) suppresses the default $1 finding text, needed for Decision 4's count-free STRICT_CORE_DEPLOY finding and to avoid duplicate/aggregate findings at the two gate-3/gate-4 call sites that separately extract per-underlying-finding lines.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — fail() also accepts an optional 3rd argument ...)*
